scope: Application conventions of the MP-05 rehearsal kit. They are not part of the DCP protocol, its profiles, its schemas or dcp-jcs-v1.

intent_binding.args_sha256: sha256: followed by the lowercase hex SHA-256 of dcp-jcs-v1(args), through the SDK canonicalizer

data_classes_rule: intent.data_classes is required and equals the action's data_classes as a set, without repeats. The scope entry of every mandate of the chain for the domain lists all of them; an entry without data_classes permits none.
limits_rule: DCP-09 section 3.5.2 rule 5 (attenuation, checked by the SDK) makes every limits key of a parent entry reappear in the sub-mandate entry with a numeric value not greater, or an identical value. What max_amount caps is a convention of this application only: args.amount, in the same unit. The application applies the operator cap and the max_amount of every mandate of the chain that declares it (defense in depth: in an admitted chain the leaf's is already the smallest); without it a mandate adds no amount cap.

ledger.key: lowercase hex SHA-256 of UTF-8(tenant) || 0x00 || UTF-8(payload_hash of the signed intent, as the SDK verified it)
ledger.semantics: At most one attempt. No exactly-once execution and no transaction with external systems. A short write fails closed.

codes.APP_INTENT_MISMATCH: the signed intent does not match the route, the action, the args or the action's data classes
codes.APP_ACTION_NOT_AUTHORIZED: the operator policy does not allow the action for this agent (direct) or principal (delegated), or the action is unknown
codes.APP_DELEGATION_NOT_ACTIVE: the composition is admitted but the delegation is not active
codes.APP_DOMAIN_OUT_OF_SCOPE: a mandate of the chain has no single scope entry for the domain
codes.APP_ACTION_OUT_OF_SCOPE: a mandate of the chain does not permit the action
codes.APP_DATA_CLASS_OUT_OF_SCOPE: a mandate of the chain does not permit the action's data classes
codes.APP_ARGS_OUT_OF_SCOPE: the amount exceeds the operator cap or the max_amount of a mandate of the chain, or a max_amount is not a safe integer
codes.APP_ALREADY_CONSUMED: the signed intent was already reserved in the ledger
